summary: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

title: Illinois will postpone implementation of crypto tax following lawsuit
summary: State officials agreed to delay the 0.2% crypto tax for six months after lawsuits and industry pushback claimed the bill was rushed through the legislature.

title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
summary: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.

title: Китайские хакеры притворялись ИИ-экспертами
